title: Design: Row menu of a standard term looks as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has customers on Net 15, and you compare a standard term's row menu with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 15 is active, is not the default and is held by at least one customer.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p1-05-row-menu-a-standard-term.png, ct-p2-01-choose-move-customers.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page, Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "⋯" on the Net 15 row.
  2. Hover "Move Customers".
  3. Hover "Deactivate".
  4. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu lists "Make Default for New Customers", "Move Customers" and "Deactivate", with their icons, and no "Edit" or "Delete Credit Term".
  • Step 2: the row turns light grey (as in ct-p2-01-choose-move-customers.png).
  • Step 3: the row turns light grey and a dark grey box opens to the LEFT of the menu reading "Hide from customer and vendor pickers" (as in ct-p1-05-row-menu-a-standard-term.png).
  • Step 4: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R1: “Each row's "⋯" menu shows only the items that apply to that term, in this order. An item that applies but is blocked shows greyed out and does nothing when clicked; hovering it shows the reason.”
  • S2-N1: “Standard terms never show "Edit" or "Delete Credit Term".”
  • S2-R3: “Hovering "Deactivate" (when not blocked) shows "Hide from customer and vendor pickers". Hovering "Reactivate" shows "Show in pickers again".”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover Deactivate / Reactivate | "Hide from customer and vendor pickers" / "Show in pickers again" | Tooltip on hover”
